story.title: About Mingo
story.belief: At Mingo Ice Cream, we believe everyone deserves to enjoy quality ice cream. After all, everybody loves ice cream.

history.title: History
history.kicker: Bringing a world of joy and fun since our humble beginnings in 2009
history.paragraphOne: Mingo Ice Cream started in 2009. Although our beginnings were humble, we brought traditional recipes from Asia to a wide range of dessert ice creams. Each recipe is thoughtfully adapted for different tastes while preserving its fresh, delicious character.
history.paragraphTwo: We put passion into every tub, cup and stick we make. Today, Mingo and our Rokka, Oasis and Fruitesia brands can be found across several countries in the region.

brands.body: From familiar flavours to new ideas, every brand has a story of its own.

joy.title: Joy in every bite!
joy.paragraphOne: Welcome to the world of Mingo Ice Cream — where boundless creativity brings you the most complete tasting experience!
joy.paragraphTwo: From the fresh, natural fruit flavours of Fruitesia and Fruttega, the tropical charm of Verano and Oasis, the bold modern style of Vivi, to the crunchy, top-tier shell of Impact, we proudly bring you a rich collection of ice cream for every taste. Don't miss the unique combination of Rokka and Sandwich, where the chewy, soft-crisp shell wraps around delicious creamy filling, creating a bite that's both uplifting and completely refreshing!
